title: Admin corrects stock with a reason that survives audit

card.i_want: to adjust a product's stock to match the shelf and record why
card.so_that: the numbers can be reconciled later and never drop below what customers have already been promised

intent: Stock drift becomes explainable rather than mysterious, and an adjustment can never quietly break a customer who is mid-payment.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an admin corrects stock upward with a reason
given: a product showing 3 available and a physical count of 5
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin adjusts it by plus 2 with the reason that a supplier delivery arrived
then: the adjustment records the admin, the time, the delta and the reason

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an adjustment without a reason is refused
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin submits it with an empty reason
then: the adjustment is refused and the stock is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an admin cannot reduce stock below the reserved quantity
given: a product with 5 available and 3 reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin tries to set available to 2
then: the customers holding the 3 reserved units are unaffected

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an adjustment to exactly the reserved quantity is allowed
given: a product with 5 available and 3 reserved

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an adjustment can never drive stock negative
given: a product with 2 available and none reserved
then: the adjustment is refused and available stays at 2

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: two admins adjusting the same product do not lose an adjustment
given: two admins submitting adjustments for one product at the same moment
then: the final quantity reflects both deltas
both adjustments appear in the audit trail

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a resubmitted adjustment applies its delta once
given: an adjustment of plus 2 already accepted for this submission
acceptance_criteria.when: the same submission arrives again after a client retry
then: available reflects a single plus 2 and not plus 4
the audit trail shows one adjustment, not two

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: every adjustment is auditable after the fact
then: the actor, time, signed delta and reason are all present and attributable

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: only an admin account may adjust stock
acceptance_criteria.when: it calls the stock adjustment function
then: the call is refused and no stock changes

pii_fields.justification: the adjusting admin is an identified staff member recorded in the audit trail
pii_fields.treatment: retained with the audit record; not shown to customers

audit_events.justification: an adjustment without an attributable record is the exact failure this story prevents

idempotency.justification: a resubmitted adjustment must not apply its delta twice

reversibility.justification: an incorrect adjustment is corrected by a further recorded adjustment, never by editing history
reversibility.compensating_action: a compensating adjustment with its own reason; the original record is never rewritten

authn_authz.justification: only an admin account may adjust stock

regulatory.justification: the Revenue Code 5-year envelope covers the adjustment records as accounting evidence

tipping_off.justification: adjustment reasons are internal and never customer-facing

cases_written: adjustment that would go negative refused
edge_case_ledger.justification: all derivations for a constraint of this shape were written

cases_written: exactly at the reserved quantity allowed
edge_case_ledger.justification: both threshold positions the rule turns on were written
all derivations for a constraint of this shape were written, including the replay case its idempotency row claims

cases_written: the adjustment is attributable after the fact
edge_case_ledger.justification: an attribution constraint has no magnitude, and concurrency is covered under RULE-STOCK-04
